name: contextos-auditor
summary: The free, local-only Agent Auditor -- attach one line to a CrewAI/LangGraph/AutoGen/OpenAI-Agents-SDK agent and watch its real token cost live. No signup, no telemetry, no data leaves your machine. Free for any use including commercial (PolyForm Shield, noncompete only) -- see LICENSE.
